items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 3:1
items.html: For the seven kings called by the name BON came out in a complete Partzuf, Rosh and Guf, and they broke, face and posterior. Therefore there are shells in them from head to foot, meaning in all of its RTS, and all the phases of the Rosh of the seven kings fell to Beria. And all the phases of the Toch of the seven kings fell to Yetzira. And all the phases of the Sof of the seven kings fell to Assiya. (p. 486, Item 2, and in Inner Light, Sub Header, “And there is”)
